note: List rates the owner console uses to turn measured usage into dollars. Change a rate here when a provider changes it, and record the date and source. Amounts are US dollars.

hosting.source: https://docs.railway.com/pricing (checked 2026-11-24): $20 per vCPU-month, $10 per GB of memory per month, $0.15 per GB-month of volume, $0.05 per GB of egress, billed by the minute
hosting.volumeGbSource: Railway metrics for the thumbgate service, 7-day average 0.27 GB on 2026-11-24
hosting.egressGbSource: Railway metrics for the thumbgate service, 7-day average about 0.01 GB per hour on 2026-11-24; not measured live by the app

email.source: https://resend.com/pricing (checked 2026-11-24): free tier 3,000 emails per month and 100 per day; Pro $20 per month for 50,000, extra emails $0.90 per 1,000
email.basis: Pro plan price divided by its included emails. While sends stay inside the free tier the true marginal cost is $0, so this is an upper bound.

payments.source: https://stripe.com/pricing and https://stripe.com/billing/pricing (checked 2026-11-24): 2.9% + 30 cents per successful domestic card charge; Stripe Billing adds 0.7% of recurring billing volume
payments.basis: Checkout fees are read from Stripe when it returns them. Renewal invoices, and any checkout whose fee was not returned, use the card rate; renewals and subscription first charges also carry the 0.7% Billing fee.

setupSprint.name: Setup Sprint
setupSprint.deliveryHoursNote: Owner time to deliver one sprint is not recorded, so sprint margin leaves labor out.

fixedNote: fixedDeliveryMonthly holds monthly costs of serving customers that usage does not measure (for example a plan minimum or a domain). buildAndInternalMonthly holds the cost of building and running the business (agent subscriptions, CI, tools). Each entry is { "name": "...", "usd": 0, "source": "..." }. Both lists are empty until a real bill is recorded; the console says so instead of guessing.
